decisions.reason: Reusable visual/course-behavior proof mode rule is supported by repeated Canvas observations plus existing locked replay and proof-strength regression coverage.
promoted: Visual/layout/course-behavior completion claims require rendered screenshot, browser, or checklist proof.
Source diffs, CSS diffs, ordinary command output, and prose do not prove visual behavior by themselves.
Meta-rule text about visual proof requirements is governance text, not a visual completion claim.
notPromoted: one-off deploy or course task details

decisions.reason: Still needs source-candidate inspection and regression backing before promotion.
Publish/sync/deploy safety rules are high value but should be split into narrow policy candidates with direct regression tests.
A previous schema-contract aggregate was already promoted; this batch should be reconciled with that artifact before adding another.
The reusable bounded handoff pattern already has a reviewed aggregate promotion artifact.
Repo-specific facts are sidecar evidence, not durable global learning.
One-off observations should not become durable learning.
